name: Crescent Zafu Cushion - Wide
description: The Wide Crescent Zafu Meditation Cushion is thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and support for deeper, more mindful meditation practice. Filled with natural organic cotton, this cushion gently elevates the hips and aligns the spine, reducing strain on the knees, ankles, and lower back during long seated sessions. Its crescent shape offers ergonomic support, allowing the body to relax into a stable and balanced posture. The Wide Zafu is perfect for those who prefer a snug, lightweight cushion that’s easy to carry and ideal for smaller spaces. Versatile in use, the Zafu can be placed directly on the floor or even on a chair, making it suitable for a variety of seated positions such as cross-legged, half lotus, or simply upright with folded legs. Whether you are new to meditation or an experienced practitioner, this cushion creates a grounded, supportive base to enhance focus and comfort. A reliable companion for yoga, meditation, or mindfulness practices, the Crescent Zafu Wide Meditation Cushion combines tradition, function, and comfort in one essential tool.

name: Lotus Yoga Mat
description: sarveda-7-chakras-yoga-mat-natural-cotton
shortDescription:
Discover our range of exquisite handwoven yoga mats embroidered with the 7 Chakras —an eco-friendly option for your practice! Compared to the synthetic materials typically used in yoga mats, such as PVC, the natural cotton mat is a more environmentally friendly option and provides a deeper connection to nature during practice. The 7 Chakras symbolize the 7 main energy channels in the human body as per the yogic system and the mat is a good place to balance your energy :)

The mats have a natural rubber grip on the back which provides excellent traction, ensuring stability and balance throughout the yoga practice. The mats are available in two grips, Moderate and Superior. The length of the Yoga Mat is 185cms long (72.5 Inches), width is 62 cms (24.5 Inches) and thickness approximately 6mm (0.2Inch) which is optimal for comfort and support.

Enhance portability by opting for a handwoven macrame strap made from natural cotton to effortlessly carry and transport your yoga mat!

name: Musical Wooden Frog
shortDescription: The musical wooden frog, also known as the wooden frog scraper is a unique instrument with a sound that mimics the croaking of a frog. The sound is produced by scraping a stick along the ridges on the back of the wooden frog, creating a percussive and rhythmic sound. It's a fairly simple-to-use instrument and can be learnt easily by all age groups. The wooden frog comes with a small wooden mallet slotted inside the frog body, which when removed is used to create the scraping sound.

name: Flower of Life with Sacred Symbols Singing Bowls
shortDescription: This beautiful range of Singing Bowls presents a diverse array of revered symbols in the east, catering to individuals exploring spirituality as well as music and art collectors. The bowl is made from Aluminium and is available in sizes ranging from 8 to 10.5 inches.  Each bowl within this foundational selection is adorned with the Flower of Life symbol in the middle, representing the essence of creation and interconnectedness.  The bowl set comes with a cushion and a mallet.   What do these different symbols printed on the bowl mean?   Flower of life The Flower of Life is a sacred geometric pattern symbolizing the interconnectedness of all life. It represents the universe's underlying structure and is used for meditation, healing, and spiritual exploration. Buddhas eyes The Buddha's eyes symbolize wisdom, compassion, and insight, representing the enlightened vision of the Buddha and his teachings guiding all sentient beings. Tree of life The Tree of Life symbolizes interconnectedness, growth, and balance across cultures. It represents the unity of all life and serves as a metaphor for spiritual evolution and personal growth. Om mani padme hum Om Mani Padme Hum" is a sacred Tibetan Buddhist mantra, translating to "The Jewel is in the Lotus." It symbolizes compassion, wisdom, and the path to enlightenment.
